school.tagged_body:
The Kim family always looked at their phones at {{v:dinner}}.
Dad watched the {{v:news}}. Mom read {{v:emails}}. Yerin played games.
Nobody talked.
One Friday, Yerin's grandpa {{g:came to visit|come to + 동사원형: ~하러 오다 (to부정사 기초)}}.
He looked at the table and {{v:shook}} his head.
Then he put an {{v:empty}} box on the table.
"This is the Phone Box," he said.
"{{g:Put your phones in here at dinner|명령문: 동사원형으로 시작해서 '~해라'}}."
At first, nobody was happy.
But soon, Dad told a {{v:funny}} story about his first job.
Mom talked about her school days.
Yerin laughed a lot.
After dinner, they played a card game for one hour.
Yerin {{g:won|win의 과거형: 이겼다 (불규칙 과거)}} two games.
Now the Kim family uses the Phone Box every night.
{{t:Dinner is Yerin's favorite time of the day}}.

The Kim family always looked at their phones at dinner. Dad watched the news, Mom read {{v:emails}}, and Yerin played games. {{v:Nobody}} talked.
One Friday, Yerin's grandpa {{g:came to visit|come to + 동사원형: ~하러 오다 (to부정사 기초)}}. He looked at the table and {{v:shook}} his head. Then he put an {{v:empty}} {{v:shoebox}} on the table. advanced.tagged_body:
Every evening, the Kim family sat around the dinner table, but they always looked at their phones {{g:instead of at each other|instead of: ~ 대신에 / each other: 서로}}. Dad watched the news, Mom {{v:checked}} her emails, and Yerin played games on her phone. Nobody said a {{v:single}} word.
One Friday, Yerin's grandpa came to visit. {{g:When he saw the quiet table|접속사 when: ~할 때}}, he shook his head {{v:sadly}}. Then he {{v:placed}} an empty shoebox in the {{v:middle}} of the table. "This is the Phone Box," he said. "From now on, everyone puts their phone in here during dinner."
At first, everyone looked unhappy and a little {{v:bored}}. But soon, Dad {{g:began to tell|begin to + 동사원형: ~하기 시작하다}} a funny story about his very first job. Mom {{v:shared}} stories about her school days, and Yerin {{g:laughed so hard that her stomach hurt|so + 부사 + that ...: 너무 ~해서 …하다}}.
After dinner, the family played a card game together for an hour. Yerin won two games and was very {{v:proud}} of herself.
Now the Kim family uses the Phone Box every night. {{t:Dinner has become Yerin's favorite time of the day}}.

For a long time, dinner at the Kim family's house was {{v:strangely}} {{v:silent}}. {{g:Although everyone sat at the same table|although: 비록 ~이지만 (양보의 접속사)}}, each person's eyes {{g:were glued to a screen|be glued to: ~에 딱 붙어 있다, ~만 뚫어지게 보다}}. Dad {{v:scrolled}} through the news, Mom answered work emails, and Yerin {{g:was busy playing games|be busy + -ing: ~하느라 바쁘다}}. {{g:Not a single word was spoken|수동태 was + 과거분사: ~되었다 (= Nobody spoke a single word)}} during the whole meal.
One Friday evening, Yerin's grandpa came over for a visit. {{g:Noticing the silent table|분사구문: ~하자, ~하면서 (= When he noticed the silent table)}}, he shook his head in {{v:disappointment}}. Without saying anything, he placed an empty shoebox in the center of the table. "This is the Phone Box," he {{v:announced}}. "From now on, every phone goes in here while we are eating dinner."
At first, nobody looked {{v:pleased}} with the new rule. Before long, however, Dad started telling a {{v:hilarious}} story about the first job {{g:he had ever had|과거완료 had + 과거분사: (그때까지) ~해 본 적이 있었다}}. Mom joined in with memories of her school days, and Yerin {{g:laughed so hard that tears came to her eyes|so + 부사 + that ...: 너무 ~해서 …하다}}.
After dinner, the family spent an {{v:entire}} hour playing a card game together, and Yerin proudly won two rounds.
These days, the Phone Box is used at the Kim family's table every single night. Thanks to Grandpa's simple idea, {{t:dinner has become the time of day that Yerin looks forward to the most}}.

questions.q: What does 'each person's eyes were glued to a screen' mean in the passage?
choices: Everyone had something in their eyes.
Everyone was fixing a broken screen.
Everyone kept looking at their phones.
Everyone was watching a movie together.
Everyone closed their eyes at dinner.
questions.answer: Everyone kept looking at their phones.
questions.explanation: be glued to는 '~에 딱 붙어 있다'라는 뜻으로, 눈이 화면에 붙어 있었다는 것은 모두가 휴대폰만 계속 보고 있었다는 뜻이다.

questions.q: Which word is closest in meaning to 'silent' in the passage?
questions.explanation: silent는 '조용한, 말이 없는'이라는 뜻으로 quiet와 의미가 가장 가깝다.

questions.q: What does 'Not a single word was spoken during the whole meal' tell us?
choices: The family spoke only one word.
The family talked in a whisper.
No one said anything while they ate.
Yerin was the only one who talked.
questions.answer: No one said anything while they ate.
questions.explanation: '단 한 마디의 말도 오가지 않았다'는 수동태 문장으로, 식사 내내 아무도 말하지 않았다는 뜻이다.

questions.q: Choose the word that best fits the blank: ____ the silent table, he shook his head in disappointment.
questions.explanation: 주절의 주어(he)가 '알아차리는' 능동의 관계이므로 현재분사로 시작하는 분사구문 'Noticing ~'이 알맞다.

questions.q: How did Grandpa react to the silent dinner table?
choices: He shook his head in disappointment and brought out a shoebox.
He laughed and joined the family's games.
He got angry and took everyone's phones home.
He turned on the TV to watch the news.
He asked Yerin to teach him a phone game.
questions.answer: He shook his head in disappointment and brought out a shoebox.
questions.explanation: 'he shook his head in disappointment'와 'he placed an empty shoebox in the center of the table'에서 알 수 있다.

questions.q: According to the new rule, when must every phone go into the Phone Box?
choices: While the family is eating dinner
questions.answer: While the family is eating dinner
questions.explanation: 'every phone goes in here while we are eating dinner'와 일치한다.

questions.q: Which is closest in meaning to 'hilarious' in the passage?
questions.explanation: hilarious는 '아주 웃기는, 몹시 재미있는'이라는 뜻이다. 예린이가 눈물이 날 정도로 웃은 것과도 연결된다.

questions.q: Choose the word that best fits the blank: Dad told a story about the first job he had ever ____.
questions.explanation: had + 과거분사(had)로 과거완료를 만든다. '그가 그때까지 가져 본 첫 직장'이라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: Which is NOT true according to the passage?
choices: Mom answered work emails at dinner.
Grandpa explained the rule for a long time before he put the box down.
Nobody looked pleased with the rule at first.
Yerin won two rounds of the card game.
The family uses the Phone Box every night now.
questions.answer: Grandpa explained the rule for a long time before he put the box down.
questions.explanation: 'Without saying anything, he placed an empty shoebox ~'라고 했으므로, 할아버지는 아무 말 없이 상자를 먼저 놓은 뒤 규칙을 알렸다.

questions.q: What does the last sentence suggest about Yerin's feelings now?
choices: She is tired of the Phone Box rule.
She misses playing games at dinner.
She wants Grandpa to take the box back.
She eagerly waits for dinner time every day.
questions.answer: She eagerly waits for dinner time every day.
questions.explanation: look forward to는 '~을 고대하다, 기다리다'라는 뜻이다. 저녁 시간이 예린이가 하루 중 가장 기다리는 시간이 되었다.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
choices: Phones make family dinners more exciting.
A simple rule helped a family reconnect and enjoy time together.
Card games are more fun than phone games.
Grandparents should not visit on Fridays.
Children should do their homework at dinner.
questions.answer: A simple rule helped a family reconnect and enjoy time together.
questions.explanation: 할아버지의 간단한 아이디어(휴대폰 상자) 덕분에 가족이 다시 대화하고 함께 즐기게 되었다는 것이 글의 요지이다.

questions.q: Although everyone sat at the same table, each person's eyes were ____ to a screen.
questions.explanation: 'each person's eyes were glued to a screen'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: Noticing the silent table, he shook his head in ____.
questions.explanation: 'he shook his head in disappointment'에서 확인할 수 있다. in disappointment는 '실망하여'라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: "This is the Phone Box," he ____.
questions.explanation: '"This is the Phone Box," he announced.'에서 확인할 수 있다. announce는 '알리다, 발표하다'라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: After dinner, the family spent an entire hour playing a card game together, and Yerin proudly won two ____.
questions.explanation: 'Yerin proudly won two rounds'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: Dinner has become the time of day that Yerin looks ____ to the most.
questions.explanation: 'Yerin looks forward to the most'에서 확인할 수 있다. look forward to는 '~을 고대하다'라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: Mom answered work emails during dinner before the Phone Box.
questions.explanation: 'Mom answered work emails'와 일치한다.

questions.q: The family played cards for only half an hour.
questions.explanation: 'the family spent an entire hour playing a card game'이라고 했으므로 한 시간 내내 했다.

questions.q: The Phone Box is now used at dinner every night.
questions.explanation: 'These days, the Phone Box is used at the Kim family's table every single night.'와 일치한다.

essays.q: Explain in English why Grandpa brought the Phone Box to the table.
essays.sampleAnswer: He brought it because everyone was looking at their phones and nobody talked during dinner.
essays.rubric: 가족이 휴대폰만 보느라 식사 중 대화가 없었다는 내용이 이유로 들어가면 만점

essays.q: Combine the two sentences using 'so ~ that': Yerin laughed very hard. Tears came to her eyes.
essays.sampleAnswer: Yerin laughed so hard that tears came to her eyes.
essays.rubric: so hard that 구조를 바르게 써서 두 문장을 한 문장으로 연결하면 만점

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 마지막 문장 'dinner has become the time of day that Yerin looks forward to the most'는 무슨 뜻인가요?
essays.sampleAnswer: 저녁 시간이 예린이가 하루 중 가장 기다리고 고대하는 시간이 되었다는 뜻이다.
essays.rubric: look forward to(고대하다)와 the most(가장)의 의미를 살려 정확히 해석하면 만점

essays.q: How did the Phone Box change the Kim family? Answer in one English sentence.
essays.sampleAnswer: The Phone Box helped the family talk, laugh, and enjoy their time together.
essays.rubric: 가족이 대화하고 함께 즐거운 시간을 보내게 되었다는 변화가 드러나면 만점

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 휴대폰을 상자에 넣은 뒤 가족이 함께 한 일을 두 가지 이상 쓰시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: 아빠는 첫 직장에 대한 아주 웃긴 이야기를 했고, 엄마는 학창 시절 추억을 이야기했으며, 저녁 식사 후에는 한 시간 동안 함께 카드 게임을 했다.
essays.rubric: 아빠의 첫 직장 이야기, 엄마의 학창 시절 이야기, 카드 게임 중 두 가지 이상 쓰면 만점, 한 가지면 부분 점수
